1_dataset_available_locally.details: Raw CTU-13 dataset not present on local machine. Absence explicitly documented.

2_dataset_can_be_parsed.details: Ctu13Adapter implemented and verified on bidirectional NetFlow (.binetflow) and CSV.

3_canonical_features_generated.details: Full 78-D canonical flow features generated (36 direct/derived from NetFlow; 78 from PCAP).

4_packet_features_generated.details: 18 packet-level features extractable via existing pcap_parser and packet_features modules.

5_network_states_280d_generated.details: Deterministic NetworkStateEncoder verified on CTU-13 flows, producing exact R^280 states.

6_temporal_sequences_t5_generated.details: Temporal sequences of shape [N, 5, 280] verified via FutureStateDatasetBuilder.

7_future_pairs_k135_generated.details: Future state pairs (S_t, S_{t+k}) for k=1, 3, 5 generated without negative delta_t.

8_scenarios_separated.details: 13 official scenarios automatically detected and tagged with scenario_id.

9_unseen_scenario_isolated.details: Scenario 10 (Rbot UDP/ICMP storm) strictly held out from train, val, and calibration.

10_phase11b_readiness.details: Pipeline, adapter, schema, and tests are 100% production ready. Benchmark execution is BLOCKED strictly pending local placement of CTU-13 data files.
